note: Catalog of UltraTensor spliced DeepSeek-V4-Coder GGUFs. Built with ultratensor/gguf_keep.py from the public BatiAI DeepSeek-V4-Pro Q3_K_M GGUF. Redistribution: verify the upstream DeepSeek model license before publishing to third parties.
serve_flags_common: --no-op-offload is mandatory on every Q3_K tier (the engine's default op-offload corrupts CPU-resident Q3_K dequants and crashes at >=36 prompt tokens).

models.desc: 64-expert dense / 384-expert hash splice. 97.66% of code routing mass on the first dense layer; 4.5x smaller than the 697.3 GB source.
models.serve: CPU only on this hardware class; mmap-stream; --no-op-offload.

models.desc: Uniform 16-expert ladder splice. The quality baseline: PPL battery mean 2.653 (code 3.000, math 2.887, multilingual 2.629, rare 2.536, needle 2.215; 8 tokens, CPU).
models.serve: CPU: llama-server -m <file> --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8780 -ngl 0 -c 512 --no-op-offload. GPU partial offload decodes but is slow (0.07-0.15 t/s).

models.desc: Uniform 8-expert ladder splice. 27.9x smaller than the source.
IQ2_XS requant of keep16u. GPU speed tier: 1.2-1.5 t/s on 8 GB VRAM (ngl 12). Quality tier it is not: PPL battery mean 8.540 with degenerate token loops (16 tokens, GPU, --no-op-offload).
models.serve: llama-server -m <file> --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8791 -ngl 12 -c 512 --no-op-offload. Long-sequence GPU decode requires the UltraTensor llama.cpp fork (cuBLAS fallback fix, commit 95fcdad); stock b10424 works for short prompts.

models.desc: IQ2_XS requant of keep12u. 1.2 t/s solo on 8 GB VRAM.
IQ2_XS requant of keep8u. Fastest per GiB on the ladder.
